title: Partial lead helper exists and only receives the typed phone or email
persona: Sunita, 48, types a number then leaves without consenting
steps: Look at capturePartial and its guard conditions for consent.
expected: capturePartial refuses to save a phone or email until values.consent is true (or the desk is told consent is false). A typed number alone is personal data.
notes: Expected to fail: capturePartial runs on blur and checks only that the phone or email is valid, with no consent check. Source rule for the live desk: partial leads go out with the disclosure text only. Founder to decide the consent position before any change. First run failed because the probe was wrong (test-design error, not a product bug): the guessed source string does not exist; partial leads are sent by submitPartialLead. Probe corrected and rerun. Case designed by Haiku; executed by Sonnet (qa/run.mjs).
